name: Elisa Meyers
description: JD's mother. Originally from Mexico; married John Meyers Sr. in 1996 and settled in Potsdam. Primary educator during the homeschooling years.
bio: JD's mother, originally from Mexico. Met John Meyers Sr. on a CFC mission trip to Spain in 1995; they married in 1996. She was the primary educator during the family's homeschooling years. Still in Potsdam.
public_footprint:
Elisa Meyers of Potsdam, NY is named in the March 2025 obituary of Norma Louise Meyers as the spouse of John Meyers (the couple are listed among the deceased's sons and their spouses, with grandchildren also named).
Sources: https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/name/norma-meyers-obituary?id=57973023
